title: Data Ingestion - Reference Data Seeding
completion_summary: Created seed-reference.ts, prisma/seed.ts, db/index.ts singleton, reference-data.ts service. Added getAllWatchProviders to TmdbClient. Idempotent upserts. Added tsx + prisma.seed config.
acceptance_criteria: Seed script fetches all movie genres from TMDB and stores in Genre table
Seed script fetches all TV genres from TMDB and stores in Genre table
Seed script fetches all watch providers and stores in WatchProvider table
Seed script is idempotent (re-running does not duplicate data)
Seed script can be run via 'npx prisma db seed' or custom npm script
All reference data persists correctly in SQLite database
TypeScript service layer for reference data operations
